name: Utility Scale Solar Technician
summary:
Utility Scale Solar Technician is an immersive VR training application developed as part of the ImmerseLearn Utility Scale Solar Technician certification program.
Designed to complement hands-on learning, the application provides students with realistic, interactive VR simulations that allow them to practice essential skills and procedures in a safe and controlled virtual environment. Learners can explore solar equipment, perform technician tasks, and build practical skills through immersive experiences.
